description: An object with `[Symbol.asyncIterator]()` whose `next()` returns a promise of an iterator result.
Loops over async iterables (and sync iterables of promises), awaiting each value.
The object returned by an `async function*`. Can both `await` and `yield`.
The consumer requests each value, so producers never run ahead of what is needed.
Collects an async iterable into an array. Never use it on infinite sources.
